# CXNM - Standard - WIN - D - Endpoint Analytics

Sends startup and performance data to Endpoint Analytics, so that slow devices become visible before users call about them.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Device config |
| Assignment | All Devices |
| Source | OpenIntuneBaseline Windows v4.0 — TP - Health Monitoring - D - Endpoint Analytics |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Endpoint_Analytics.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Endpoint_Analytics.json) |
